dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: What about it? Has your investigation revealed something?

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Goodness... I wonder when it could have appeared here?

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Thank you for investigating, I'll report the situation to the Guild. Here's your reward.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you have a commission for me?

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: A commission, you say? Your timing couldn't have been better! I was just thinking I should find an experienced adventurer to investigate the strange air current.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Let me give you a bit of background. Not long ago, a small team of explorers went on an expedition up the mountain. A few highly experienced adventurers joined them, and they took a safe route that avoided all the known dangerous spots.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: But somehow, they fell foul of a sudden and powerful current of cold air along their way and were forced to return to the camp.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: I spoke to the adventurers when they got back. They said that it shouldn't have been possible for an air current that strong to appear on the trail they were following. Apparently, it just came out of nowhere. It doesn't seem like it was a naturally occurring phenomenon.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Since then, numerous explorers and surveyors have reported encountering the same situation. After organizing a few investigations of our own, we now believe that we have pinpointed the source of the air current.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, all the adventurers who have taken part in the investigations so far are still recuperating from frostbite, muscular fatigue, and other issues, so our investigations have temporarily ground to a halt...

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Traveler, if you are willing, could you continue investigating the source of the air current on our behalf?

response.speaker: Iris
response.text: Many thanks. Make sure you're well-prepared before you set off — whatever is causing this is most unnatural.

response.speaker: Iris
response.text: If you've no further questions, I will leave you to proceed with the investigation. Many thanks for your assistance.

response.speaker: Iris
response.text: Oh... Straight to the point, I see. Don't worry, the Guild is not in the business of short-changing its adventurers. I will have a reward waiting for you when you return to the camp.

response.speaker: Iris
response.text: As for the size of said reward... That will be determined based on the value of your findings. You know the score, right?
